content:
Multiple new Apple Watch Series 12 models continue to offer pre-order discounts, with AirPods 5 Active Noise Cancellation version dropping to a low of $125, as Amazon's Fall Prime Day early bird deals kick off. In addition to AirPods Pro 3 being discounted by $50, we've also noticed Amazon has relaunched pre-order discounts on the base M6 Mac mini as well as the 24GB model. Other deals include $150 off the M5 MacBook Air, Apple 2026 Studio Display XDR returning to its lowest price ever on Amazon with $330 off, $80 off Hyper 2026 Thunderbolt 5 Dock, and an exclusive discount on the Bluebonnet Saddle Tan genuine leather iPhone 18 Pro case with copper buttons. See details below.

Amazon Fall Prime Day early bird deals now live: Apple, Pixel, Anker, Grubhub $20 off, and more

AirPods 5 Active Noise Cancellation version at $125 with Friday delivery, AirPods Pro 3 at $199

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (original price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (original price $549)
  • AirPods 5 $125 (original price $129)
  • AirPods 5 with wireless charging case $149

Amazon relaunches pre-order discount on base model M6 Mac mini

The new model ships next week, and Amazon has just restored pre-order discount deals on Apple's new base M6 Mac mini.

This morning we saw Amazon reopen pre-order deals on the higher-end 24GB model, and friends looking to get the base new M6 mini can once again enjoy early bird pre-order deals.

Amazon is once again selling the 2026 Apple M6 Mac mini with 16GB RAM and 256GB storage for $879.99 with free shipping.

Prices have been fluctuating recently and may disappear and reappear at any time before the launch date.

The discount is certainly not large, but this is the only chance to save money directly before next week's delivery — saving $20 is good too — what Amazon offers is exactly the same as Apple's official store.

Here's a roundup of early bird pre-order discounts on the new M6, M5 Max and Mac Studio series:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (original price $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (original price $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (original price $1,299)
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (original price $1,699)
  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,450 (original price $2,499)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,649 (original price $1,799)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (original price $1,599)

Apple 2026 Studio Display XDR returns to its lowest price ever on Amazon with $330 off

Discounts on Apple's latest 2026 Studio Display series have been on and off this month, and we once again see the Apple Studio Display XDR with tilt and height-adjustable stand at a new low — $330 off.

Amazon is now selling the latest Apple Studio Display XDR with standard glass and tilt and height-adjustable stand for $2,969 with free shipping.

Originally priced at $3,299, this high-end XDR display with the excellent tilt and height-adjustable stand is now $330 off, reaching the lowest price we've tracked.

Amazon has seen this same deal a few times this month, but this model has never dropped below $3,150 before.

Apple launched an upgraded new Studio Display this spring, as gorgeous as ever, and of course the price is as high as ever, but if you ask me, it's definitely the most beautiful display to match the new M6 Mac mini and Mac Studio.

More Apple Watch Series 12 models join Amazon's early bird pre-order deals

The all-new Apple Watch Series 12 will arrive within 48 hours. Same as AirPods 5 at $125, multiple models are now enjoying Amazon's early bird pre-order deals. These slight discounts have been appearing on Amazon earlier this week, and now more case colors, sizes and band options have joined — we've listed them all below.

Of course, these aren't big discounts, but they are the best cash discounts across the web before the Series 12 goes on sale. If you still want to pre-order this week and receive it as soon as possible, Amazon offers the lowest price, and almost all models can still ship on Friday (as of writing):

  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm: $490 (original price $499)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm: $679 (original price $699)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm Milanese band: $729 (original price $749)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 46mm: $440 (original price $449)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 46mm: $540 (original price $549)

Hyper 2026 Thunderbolt 5 Dock returns to low price on Amazon with $80 off: SSD enclosure, triple monitor support, and more

Not all expansion docks are the same. In my experience, these types of products are usually worth spending more money on, especially if you're a Mac user looking to set up a multi-monitor configuration. This year's HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with built-in SSD enclosure is a solid choice, suitable for both professional workstations and home computers — and it's now back to its lowest price ever ($80 off).

Hyper's official Amazon store is once again selling the 2026 HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD enclosure for $319.99 with free shipping.

This package originally priced at $400 is now $80 off, reaching the lowest price we've tracked on Amazon. We've seen this deal on and off over the past few months, and it's back now — same as Prime Day pricing in June this year.

That said, it's still a significant investment, but it may be worth it for those looking for a heavy-duty top-tier dock. Solid metal body with triple monitor support, suitable for Windows PC and MacBook Pro M5 Pro/Max (2026):

You can also expand storage through the built-in M.2 PCIe Gen 4 x4 and Gen 3 slots, and enjoy 120Gbps Thunderbolt 5 speeds, along with the following connectivity options:

  • 2 Thunderbolt 5 downstream ports
  • 3 USB-A (10Gbps)
  • RJ-45 2.5Gbps Ethernet
  • 3.5mm audio
  • Nano + standard security lock slot
  • 140W power delivery
  • DC 20V power supply

Bluebonnet Saddle Tan genuine leather iPhone 18 Pro case with copper buttons — 9to5 readers exclusive 20% off
